readme:
# Douyin Daren Core Metrics API

Fetch core Douyin creator milestone metrics by providing the creator's numeric identifier in `user_id`.

## Use cases

- Analyze milestone metrics for Douyin creators.
- Evaluate creator item performance benchmarks.
- Monitor influencer engagement indicators across Douyin accounts.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/douyin/index/daren-great-item-mile-info" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"user_id": "<user_id>"}'
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `user_id` | string | Yes | Douyin uid (numeric, e.g. "3100268042915212") |

## Notes

- The `user_id` parameter requires a numeric Douyin UID string.

## Pricing

Flat price per call. Failed calls, including lookups whose target does not exist, are not charged.
